title: Anagama Wood and Soda Firings
source_quote: We fire the kiln twice a year, in mid-fall and late spring.
evidence_sentence: Gustin Ceramics fires their anagama kiln twice yearly using wood, in mid-fall and late spring.
evidence_quote: We use about eight cords of wood for the firing, a mixture of both oak and pine.
summary: Participate in wood firings of the anagama kiln at Gustin Ceramics twice yearly (mid-fall and late spring). Contact gustinceramics@gmail.com to inquire about participating.
how_to_join: Email gustinceramics@gmail.com to inquire about participating in firings.
commitment: Four days to load, six days to fire, up to two weeks to cool
